_comment: Read by .claude/hooks/intake-gate.js and trace-gate.js; any missing key falls back to these defaults. harness-bootstrap sets guardedRoots to this repository's code roots (for example ["src", "scripts"]). While guardedRoots is empty, every path outside exemptRoots is gated. Markdown and .txt files are not gated, except under guardedDocRoots (for repositories whose docs are the product, e.g. ["docs/design"]).
